column3: MT 75:1–2; the following verses of this psalm are MT +1. Close to the Hebrew; “Al-tashcheth” is translated “Set to ‘Do Not Destroy,’” and “your name is near; they recount your wonders” becomes “Your wondrous works declare that Your name is near.”
Close to the Hebrew; NKJV marks the verse as God’s speech with quotation marks.
Close to the Hebrew; “I set in order its pillars” is rendered “I set up its pillars firmly.”
Close to the Hebrew; “speak with a neck” is rendered “speak with a stiff neck.”
Close to the Hebrew; “the going out,” “the setting,” and “the wilderness” are rendered “the east,” “the west,” and “the south.”
Close to the Hebrew; חָמַר (“foams”) is rendered “is red.”
